infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EmberlyMaintenance attaches photos from your library to property-map annotations.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: EmberlyMaintenance uses your location to render the property map's day and night appearance accurately.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: EmberlyMaintenance uses the microphone so you can dictate work-order notes instead of typing them.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: EmberlyMaintenance transcribes your dictated notes on this device. The audio is not sent to Apple or to Emberly.
